name: What soundproofing is needed between living areas?

mainEntity.name: What soundproofing is needed between living areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Double drywall with green glue, staggered studs, resilient channels, and carpeted floors between suites and shared spaces minimize noise transmission between generations.
